shared_elements: repeated short parallel strokes forming a band-like row
justification: The only correspondence is generic: both surfaces bear schematic engraved/carved lines, including arcs and rows of short repeated strokes, which any linear tradition could produce. A depicts a complete anthropomorphic being with a face, headdress, arms, chest bands and a prominent disc arranged around a body axis, whereas B shows detached, abstract elongated boat- or comb-like linear motifs scattered across the surface with no figural or bodily organisation.
